cases.assertion: Checked literal evidence satisfies the secret contract without a fabricated graph; deployment assumptions remain in POC readiness.
Inspect the static registration and Auth implementation; query truncation alone does not establish unknown reachability.
A shell injection claim and a single-argument option injection claim are distinct; blocked shell evaluation needs scoped counter-evidence.
Assess the actual uploaded filename and save/delete operation; do not assert a matched dependency implementation unavailable in the repository.
Environment configuration control differs from remote request control; unresolved configuration trust boundaries remain explicit.
A request trigger does not establish influence over a literal destination; an adjacent race does not decide the SSRF claim.
ReadBody writes remote request bodies; ordinary application writes do not establish symlink prepositioning or replacement capability.
The writer mutex does not cover PrintFlag; a returned constant marker does not prove file-content disclosure.
Auth is registered in InitRouter and only sets a header; identifying an authentication vulnerability still requires a protected operation and impact.
A checked whole function body is not merely a reused route declaration; body evidence remains frozen and source validated.
Ordinary traversal and preexisting symlink traversal require separate mechanisms and preconditions.
Receiving an external signal is not synchronization with server initialization in a separate goroutine.
Compare the same configuration trust boundary with the related candidate without borrowing evidence refs.
Debug mode is a review signal, not proof of a concrete disclosure or deployed security impact.
Separate source-visible growth and limits from unobserved deployment bounds; an executed exhaustion POC is not a static verdict prerequisite.
Compare exact static exposure mechanisms and inspect Auth before attributing control to it.
Use the same server lifecycle facts as the startup candidate; a static race and its demonstrated security impact are separate judgments.
Do not merge same-site state claims unless their actor, mechanism and remedy agree; preserve local directory replacement unknowns.
Reuse checked process operation semantics for taxonomy compatibility without treating them as proof of an exploitable option or impact.
Option support and single-token impact may depend on an unavailable external executable; preserve that boundary.
External executable integrity requires an attacker-controlled deployment capability; do not merge it with argument injection merely because the API is shared.

fact_checks.fact: The writer serializes its own critical section; this says nothing about an unlocked reader.
fact_checks.forbidden_inference: The writer mutex protects every read of the shared file.
fact_checks.repair_constraint: Account for both producer and consumer when synchronizing or changing resource lifetime.

fact_checks.fact: The reader is unlocked and responds with a constant after length checks.
fact_checks.forbidden_inference: This response discloses the bytes read from the file.
fact_checks.repair_constraint: Do not conflate a state-consistency defect with proven sensitive-data disclosure.

fact_checks.fact: The application registers Auth before its routes.
fact_checks.forbidden_inference: Registration proves successful authentication or a particular middleware order at runtime.
fact_checks.repair_constraint: Inspect the callback body and identify the operation requiring authorization.

fact_checks.fact: The complete function sets a response header and continues; it contains no identity check.
fact_checks.forbidden_inference: A function named Auth proves a logged-in user boundary.
fact_checks.repair_constraint: Do not describe the caller as authenticated solely because this middleware is present.

fact_checks.fact: The source cleans the supplied relative path without prepending a separator; object-ownership and traversal are separate claims.
fact_checks.forbidden_inference: A traversal concern proves the original object-ownership claim or that Clean removes every parent component.
fact_checks.repair_constraint: Address the reviewed mechanism without silently replacing its trust boundary.

fact_checks.fact: The application selects a broad filesystem root and passes false to LocalFile; the dependency implementation and deployment permissions are outside this source block.
fact_checks.forbidden_inference: The application can list the directory or read every protected file under that root.
fact_checks.repair_constraint: Confine the intended public assets and state process-readability and library-semantics assumptions.

contains: db.Exec("CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS " + dbname)
fact_checks.fact: This operation concatenates a configuration value, not a request value visible at this site; trace the definition before deciding control.
fact_checks.forbidden_inference: A remotely triggered operation establishes remote control over its configuration operand.
fact_checks.repair_constraint: Distinguish deployer configuration from an untrusted configuration supplier.

fact_checks.fact: The path is predictable but platform-dependent; request body writes do not establish symlink prepositioning or replacement capability.
fact_checks.forbidden_inference: The temporary directory is always /tmp, or normal remote writes prove local replacement authority.
fact_checks.repair_constraint: Keep local replacement capability and victim permissions explicit when they are decisive.

acceptance: Assess three layers independently: source/protocol admission, report propagation, and human semantic review against fact_checks. Source substring checks establish fixture facts only, never natural-language truth or a fixed model verdict. Existing model statuses are not semantic ground truth. Real external unknowns need not become confirmed or rejected.
